consumer_lines.source: foreach($taskF in (Get-TaskEntries $taskDataRoot $true 60)){Spend-Task 2;Assert-NoLink $taskF.Item1;if($taskF.Item3){continue};$taskRelative=[IO.Path]::GetRelativePath($taskDataRoot,$taskF.Item1).Replace([char]92,[char]47);$taskNames.Add($taskRelative);if(-not $taskCaps.ContainsKey($taskRelative)){throw 'Unknown reference output before admission'};$taskH=Get-TaskHash $taskF.Item1 $taskCaps[$taskRelative];if($taskH['bytes'] -gt 152627224L-$taskBytes){throw 'Complete reference pool cap'};$taskBytes+=$taskH['bytes'];$taskRows.Add(@{path=$taskF.Item1;relative_path=$taskRelative;bytes=$taskH['bytes'];sha256=$taskH['sha256'];origin_bundle_sha256=$taskExpectedManifest})}

foreach($taskF in (Get-TaskEntries $taskBuildRoot $false 4)){if($taskF.Item3 -or -not $taskBuildCaps.ContainsKey($taskF.Item2)){throw 'Compiler final artifact set is not admitted'};$taskH=Get-TaskHash $taskF.Item1 $taskBuildCaps[$taskF.Item2];if($taskH['bytes'] -gt 67108864L-$taskSum){throw 'Compiler final aggregate not admitted'};$taskSum+=$taskH['bytes'];$taskSeen.Add($taskF.Item2);$taskRows.Add(@{path=$taskF.Item1;bytes=$taskH['bytes'];sha256=$taskH['sha256'];origin_bundle_sha256=$taskExpectedManifest})}
